name: Redwoods Daytime Treewalk
description: Walk the elevated bridges and platforms of the Redwoods Treewalk through Rotorua’s forest canopy.

location.label: 1 Long Mile Road / Tītokorangi Drive, Whakarewarewa, Rotorua 3010, New Zealand

considerations.text: The operator states the elevated Treewalk is not wheelchair accessible. Review walking and young-child requirements before booking.

verification.notes: Researched against cited sources; awaiting independent human editorial approval. The published approximate duration is 30–40 minutes from the first bridge; 40 minutes is the operator’s approximate completion figure and excludes queues.

price.notes: The operator FAQ explicitly identifies all prices as New Zealand dollars. Nightlights, Glowworms and Altitude are different products.

name: Waiotapu Thermal Wonderland geothermal park
description: Visit Waiotapu’s geothermal landscape and view the park’s volcanic features from its marked paths.

location.label: 201 Waiotapu Loop Road, RD 3, Rotorua 3073, New Zealand

considerations.text: Active geothermal hazards: stay on marked paths, remain behind barriers and follow staff instructions. The operator recommends sturdy footwear and adult supervision for children.

verification.notes: Researched against cited sources; awaiting independent human editorial approval. Price unavailable: the official linked booking page did not expose a usable price during research. Do not import conflicting third-party amounts. Visit duration and seasonal suitability remain unresearched.
